readWrite.component: Package\Foreach Loop Container\Create And Update Heir\Trim All Input Columns 1
readWrite.expression: reflection over every string property of the heir row: if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(str)) str = str.Trim(); if (str == "") str = null

readWrite.component: Package\Foreach Loop Container\Create And Update Heir\Trim All Input Columns
readWrite.expression: reflection over every string property of the contact row (MACHOZ, MIS_TIK, MIS_BAKASHA, gen_customeridentitynumber, gen_issueanceofanorderdate): if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(str)) str = str.Trim(); if (str == "") str = null

readWrite.component: Package\Foreach Loop Container\Create And Update Heir\Append Zeros To Fields
readWrite.expression: FormatField(str, input column length 9): if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(str)) str = ""; if (str.Contains(".")) str = str.Replace(".", ""); while (str.Length < 9) str = "0" + str — applied to gen_identitynumber and gen_customeridentitynumber (NULL becomes "000000000")

readWrite.component: Package\Foreach Loop Container\Create And Update Heir\Format Dates
readWrite.expression: FormatYYYYMMDDtoDate(str, 50): NULL/empty → NULL; str.Trim().Length == 8 → str.Substring(0,4) + "/" + str.Substring(4,2) + "/" + str.Substring(6,2); == 6 → yyyy + "/" + MM + "/01"; any other length → NULL; NULL if !DateTime.TryParse(str)
